ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram shown, which is the producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a food chain from left to right, with arrows pointing in order from a clump of grass to a grasshopper, then to a frog, then to a snake, and finally to a hawk. Reasoning: The question asks who the producer in this food web is. Producers are usually plants that can make their own food and are located at the beginning of the food chain. The only plant in the diagram, and also the beginning of the food chain, is grass, so the producer is grass.
